projects.title: What I've Built
projects.description: Some projects I've created or participated in

items.title: Automated Service Platform
items.description: Full-featured Telegram-based system with advanced admin panel, callback architecture, ticket and user management. Integrated middleware layers (rate limiting, blocks, maintenance window), real-time notifications via Celery, Redis caching, Prometheus + Grafana monitoring, automatic weekly Excel reports and alert system.

items.title: FastAPI Backend
items.description: High-performance REST API in Python with asynchronous request processing, Celery task queues and Redis caching.

items.title: This Website
items.description: Full-featured portfolio website with modern glassmorphism design, interactive 3D tilt effects, floating particles animation, i18n localization. Backend on FastAPI with Kafka queues, Redis caching, PostgreSQL, Telegram bot for notifications. Complete CI/CD coverage with GitHub Actions, E2E tests (Playwright), unit tests (Jest, pytest), linting and security scanning.

services.title: End-to-end mini solutions
services.description: Three typical directions aligned with your process

items.title: Omnichannel aggregators
items.problem: Sales loses leads when clients write in Telegram, WhatsApp, on the site, and VK at once.
items.solution: A microservice accepts REST webhooks, normalizes threads, and forwards to a Telegram bot for replies or into your CRM.
items.stack: Python/C#, PostgreSQL, Docker on your VPS

items.title: Media and documents
items.problem: Hours spent on call transcripts, data from scanned invoices, and processing video reviews.
items.solution: Bots and internal services: meeting audio → summary and tasks via API to Jira/Trello/Bitrix.
items.stack: Whisper & LLM APIs, RabbitMQ/Kafka for load

items.title: Data synchronization
items.problem: Legacy accounting and a new site diverge; stock levels updated manually once a day.
items.solution: A reliable gateway: scheduled or broker-driven fetch, transform, and safe writes to the site DB or CRM.
items.stack: Java/C#, strict typing, gRPC between services when needed
